Recaps & history

See your fishing life take shape over time.

A single trip tells you about one day. A year can show you where you kept going, what you caught, who came with you, and how your time changed with the seasons.

Not rankings.
Your own record.

Browse your history

Return to old trips, catches, places, photos, notes, and routes without digging through several apps.

See the calendar fill in

A calendar view can show the rhythm of a fishing year in a way a list cannot—the busy months, the long gaps, the stretches when you seemed to get out every chance you had.

Notice your own patterns

Over time, see the places you return to, the species that show up most often, the months you fish most, the people you fish with most, and the trips that stand out.

These are not rankings. They are simply part of your own record.

Look back on the year

Annual recaps can turn a year of separate outings into something easier to see as a whole. The point is not to declare a winner. It is to remember the year you actually had.

Let the journal become more valuable with time

The longer you use Cast Your Line, the more history you have to return to. That is the point.
